member.name: T:AndanteTribe.IO.CryptoFileAccessor
member.summary: A file accessor that encrypts and decrypts file content using AES-CBC encryption with HMAC-SHA256 integrity verification. Implements the decorator pattern by wrapping another instance.
member.remarks: The on-disk format is: [HMAC-SHA256 (32 bytes)][random IV (16 bytes)][AES-CBC ciphertext]. A fresh random IV is generated for every write, so the same plaintext never produces the same ciphertext twice. The HMAC covers both the IV and the ciphertext, so any tampering is detected before decryption.

member.summary: Derives a dedicated HMAC key from the master AES key so that the same key material is never used for two different cryptographic operations.
member.remarks: This uses HMAC-SHA256 with a fixed label as a simple key derivation function (KDF). This is equivalent to the HKDF-Extract step and is the recommended approach for .NET Standard 2.1, where is not available.
member.param: The master encryption key.
